note: Questions that tickets put to the owner on 2026-10-22 and 2026-10-23 (13 tickets in Needs owner at once; 18 escalations against 21 answers in two hours). JAIF-130, JAIF-220, JAIF-222, JOOWP-301, JOOWP-303, JOOWP-304, JOOWP-308 and JOOWP-312 are the ones named in JAIF-255; the others are the rest of the same families. 'reaches_person' is what must be true once triage has run.

escalations.description:
Acceptance criteria:
- AC1: the retry works
escalations.text: The CI of my pull request fails and I need the log of the failing CI job to fix it. I cannot see the GitHub Actions log from here. Please provide the CI job log.

escalations.description:
Acceptance criteria:

escalations.text: Playwright cannot start: there is no Chromium browser installed for the run. I need a browser to check the Machines screen.

escalations.text: My command p='src/auth/provider.ts' was refused by the command policy (not in the project's command policy). I think I have a write restriction on src/auth/provider.ts. Who can grant me write access?

escalations.description:

escalations.description:
